systems.name: Shared game runtime
systems.evidence: analysis/actor_model.json and the ov005 script handler establish script-to-actor calls into ov001. Only reviewed function roles receive named subsections.

subsections.name: Actor animation
subsections.evidence: Confirmed actor animation setup/frame operations in the reviewed actor_model evidence and exact-matched source entries; visible clip identity remains unknown. See analysis/actor_model.json.

subsections.name: Actor state and appearance
subsections.evidence: Confirmed script-driven actor parameter, translucency and node-offset operations. The user-visible appearance for each command is not fully established. See analysis/actor_model.json.

subsections.name: Script commands
subsections.evidence: Confirmed operand-reading/dispatch handlers for actor commands; actual game semantics stay bounded by each function evidence. See analysis/actor_model.json.

subsections.name: Object creation
subsections.evidence: analysis/overlay_loading.json: SetOverlayObjectFactory stores the factory callback at 0x020a04a0; ov060 registers CreateOverlay060Object through it. This establishes factory registration, not the created object's gameplay class.

subsections.name: Script commands
subsections.evidence: One exact-matched command handler; its downstream game-facing effect is unresolved. See analysis/actor_model.json.

systems.name: Movie playback
systems.evidence: analysis/movie_playback.json records the ov022 movie context, decoder and stream callers. ov003 contains the corresponding movie stream opener, established by exact recovered shared source.

subsections.name: Movie stream I/O
subsections.evidence: Matched routines open, seek, or read movie stream data; the ov003/ov022 open-stream sources have matching behavior, and ov022 aligned read-ahead is explicitly filesystem I/O.

subsections.name: Movie stream initialization
subsections.evidence: Ghidra body at ov022:0x020a9430 validates movie headers and allocates decoder, plane, and startup stream state; analysis/movie_playback.json records the direct calls. Ghidra records its caller at 020a9194, contained in the inventoried wrapper 020a9170; the wrapper is included as an unmatched initialization dependency.

subsections.name: Movie audio
subsections.evidence: Matched source bodies start/flush stereo PCM or stop movie audio; source paths and exact compilation are recorded in matches.json.

subsections.name: Movie stream decoding and frame conversion
subsections.evidence: Matched routines decode frame slots, drop frames, convert planes, and process chunks. Ghidra call chain and typed field evidence are recorded in analysis/movie_playback.json; helper roles are based on exact source or explicit helper arguments. Ghidra shows 020a9398 forwarding to the chunk processor; the processor directly dispatches its chunk types to 020aaac8, 020aaadc, 020aac34 and 020ab5f4. These related unmatched handlers remain in this denominator; individual codec semantics are unconfirmed.

subsections.name: Frame timing and presentation setup
subsections.evidence: Matched movie timer/hardware routines plus Ghidra frame wrapper and plane helper. These functions update frame request/ring state or configure the movie display path; the output-to-display path remains partly unknown.

subsections.name: Movie stream I/O
subsections.evidence: Matched routines open, seek, or read movie stream data; the ov003/ov022 open-stream sources have matching behavior, and ov022 aligned read-ahead is explicitly filesystem I/O.

subsections.name: Decoder and conversion resources
subsections.evidence: Exact matched cache helpers load decoder or pixel conversion tables used by the initialization and conversion paths in Ghidra evidence.

systems.name: Display sessions and panels
systems.evidence: analysis/display_session.json and analysis/panel_state.json establish display-session state and panel calls through the ov039 shared context and resource helpers. Specific scenes and menus remain unknown.

subsections.name: Display session
subsections.evidence: All eight functions in ov026 are included; display-session lifecycle is established, scene identity is unknown. See analysis/display_session.json.

subsections.name: ov039 state field access
subsections.evidence: Both functions access the same global state pointer at 0x020BEA00 and the same word at offset 0xC9C4; one stores its argument and the other returns the word.
subsections.uncertainty: The word's runtime meaning is not established. These two functions form a confirmed pair, but do not define the larger state/setup subsystem.

subsections.name: Overlay resource handle and object helpers
subsections.evidence: Ghidra call sites show 0x020BC220 called from each of the five neighboring helpers. It reads a handle at state+0xCAB4+group*4 and packs that handle with the low nine bits of the supplied index. The callers pass the result into ARM9 resource/object routines and subsequently operate on returned objects.
subsections.uncertainty: The identities of the resource groups and the rendered/game objects are not known; the five clients appear related by the shared helper but may have distinct purposes.

subsections.name: Overlay callback and event dispatch
subsections.evidence: The lifecycle functions load/unload IDs from parallel tables and maintain active indices; the hook wrappers dispatch through table record pointers. The callback utility calls a nonnull function pointer. The 12 120-byte wrappers at 0x020BD084–0x020BD5AC repeatedly select callback slots from handler records and are called as input/event dispatch paths. This group intentionally includes unmatched lifecycle and hook neighbors around the exact-match wrappers.
subsections.uncertainty: The primary/secondary callback tables' semantic event names and the overlay's user-facing role are unresolved; record fields should remain address/offset based.

subsections.name: Selection and input state processing
subsections.evidence: These adjacent functions read and update the shared ov039 state, and Ghidra pseudocode for the larger routines checks input/state flags, updates indices and coordinates, and calls neighboring helpers. Together they form the stateful update path surrounding the callback-dispatch layer.
subsections.uncertainty: Specific key meanings, coordinate units, and visible-menu identity remain unknown; grouping is provisional pending verified full call-graph review.

subsections.name: Panel state
subsections.evidence: All ten functions in ov088 are included; display/resource/table state setup is known, menu/scene identity is unknown. See analysis/panel_state.json.

subsections.name: Overlay loading
subsections.evidence: All six functions in ov051 are included; static overlay selections and factory registrations are known, gameplay class identity is unknown. See analysis/overlay_loading.json.

subsections.name: Object creation
subsections.evidence: Both functions in ov060 are included; factory allocation/init chain is established, object gameplay role is unknown. See analysis/overlay_loading.json.
